title: check-expected-skips reads scaffold-e2e.yml's by-design 'Registry canary' skip as outside the roster (exit 4) on every PR that touches create-objectstack
body:
Filing gate: **③ a defect in a PM loop tool**, measured. `reach:` every PR whose diff selects `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` (it is path-filtered to `create-objectstack`): the enqueue bar's skip reading answers exit 4 on a by-design skip, so the landing seat must hand-classify it each time. Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, session `local_1d2a197c-c20e-4e90-9be8-413d4d432289`) while landing PR #20748. ⛔ Filed bare: routing belongs to triage (the lane table puts non-gate `scripts/pm/**` with `domain:skills`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured

`node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 20748` at head `a84b73af13`:
- 40 check-runs: 32 success, 8 skipped; 7 skips in the roster;
- `⛔ unexpected skips (1) — outside the roster: Registry canary: ${{ matrix.template }}` (run `36658032070`, the `Scaffold E2E` workflow on `pull_request`), classified by the tool as `filter-miss: skipped before matrix expansion (the name is the raw template): a job-level if: or needs gate did not select this head`;
- `VERDICT … 1 skipped check-run(s) outside the roster (exit 4)`.

## Why it is by design

`.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml:464-465` declares `name: 'Registry canary: ${{ matrix.template }}'` with `if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'`. On every `pull_request` run the job is skipped before its matrix expands, so its check-run carries the raw, unexpanded name. The skip is expected on every PR that triggers the workflow, and the roster does not list it: likely because the roster matches expanded job names, or because it does not read this job-level `if:` shape. That is for the fix to measure.

## Fix shape

Teach the roster this job (a schedule/dispatch-only job-level `if:`, under its raw matrix name), so `check-expected-skips --pr` answers exit 0 for a `create-objectstack` PR whose only extra skip is this one. Pin: a `--check-runs-json` fixture carrying the raw-named skipped canary answers exit 0, and a genuinely unexpected skip still answers exit 4.

Dedupe: a search for `check-expected-skips Registry canary` and `expected-skips roster matrix` finds no open card. Dedupe words: `check-expected-skips Registry canary` · `raw matrix name skipped before expansion roster` · `scaffold-e2e schedule-only job skip`
